sources.title: [2205.13147] Matryoshka Representation Learning - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Our main contribution is Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) which encodes information at different granularities and allows a single embedding to adapt to the computational constraints of downstream tasks. MRL minimally modifies existing representation learning pipelines and imposes no additional cost during inference and deployment.
